Ellen (docs): quick thread: creating a compact "migration sprint" note for customers moving from Legacy SDK -> Optimize toolkit. single screen, 3 copy-paste examples (batching json, kv-prefetch minimal SDK, quick quant note), a short 3-step checklist, and two canonical links. keep it actionable.
Marco (eng-runtime): good. please include a tiny curl vs SDK auth example and call out the SSE header for streaming. we've seen a few support tickets around that.
Yara (opt): add a 1-sentence rule for when to use dynamic_batch auto vs manual caps. also include a short note about when 4-bit quant (q4) is worth testing.
Felix (pm): product blurb: "Typical wins: better p95 and lower token spend; watch for regressions on very short prompts." keep customer-facing.
Ellen (docs): drafting now. Marco, can you paste a minimal kv-prefetch SDK snippet (3 lines) for me to drop in?
Marco (eng-runtime): use this tiny example:```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = cli.generate("tl;dr: condense to 1 sentence", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Ellen (docs): perfect. i'll add an italic note: "prefetch gives wins when prefix reuse is high (>50%)." Yara, your quant one-liner?
Yara (opt): "Prefer int8 for mature batch workloads where throughput matters; prefer fp16/bf16 for latency-sensitive short requests. Consider 4-bit (q4) profiles for experimental bulk runs but only after a 50-sample fidelity check."
Ellen (docs): added. batching JSON (copy/paste ready for Dedicated config):```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 3072,
    "min_requests": 3,
    "timeout_ms": 15
  }
}
```
Marco (eng-runtime): nice. short note suggestion: if p95 climbs, drop timeout_ms to 8 and lower max_batch_tokens. Also include this curl vs SDK auth snippet for users migrating from v2:```http
# Legacy v2 curl (old header):
curl -H "Authorization: Token $OLD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# Recommended v3 curl / streaming:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Ellen (docs): adding that. checklist at top: 1) run 20-50 sample smoke eval, 2) enable kv-prefetch for routes with high prefix overlap, 3) tune batching caps or leave dynamic_batch=auto if traffic steady.
Felix (pm): add a one-line rollback tip: "Console -> Deployments -> Routes -> choose previous model variant -> promote."
linkbot: PR #10456 opened by Ellen 94optkit-migration-sprint-note94. CI: docs-lint OK; linkcheck reported 1 broken link.
Ellen (docs): ack. route link probably points to an old path. Marco, canonical kv-prefetch link? and telemetry link?
Marco (eng-runtime): use these: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/kv-prefetch and https://docs.redwood.ai/console/telemetry-guide. update in PR.
Ellen (docs): updated. also added the short troubleshooting row: "If latency increases after enabling prefetch, disable it and re-run a 20-sample smoke eval; check prefix similarity and request sizes."
linkbot: linkcheck re-run 94passing94. PR #10456 merged. :tada:
